title: Replay a repeated idempotency key with the stored outcome

facts.note: Role (PLT-84), mapped to paths by the structure profile.
The task asks for repeat-safe mutations.
Observer: a mutating boundary handler or use case is added or changed.

fires: A mutating endpoint accepts a client-supplied key and must not apply the effect twice.
doesNotFire: Mutations the requirement does not ask to be repeat-safe.

given: A mutating operation that accepts a client-supplied idempotency key
when: the same key arrives again with the same request
then: Return the outcome stored for that key without executing the effect again and without recomputing the outcome from current state or configuration.
prefer: Persist the key, a request fingerprint and the full outcome in the same atomic step as the effect.
Look up the key before any effect, inside the same serialisation as the effect.
Scope keys to the caller so one caller cannot read another caller's stored outcome.
avoid: Re-running the computation on replay, which drifts when configuration or state changes.
Recording the key in a separate step after the effect, leaving a window for double execution.
why: Clients retry after timeouts; a replay that re-executes or recomputes either double-applies the effect or returns a different answer for the same request.
evidence: A test repeats the request and observes an identical response and no additional effect.
A test changes relevant configuration between the two calls and still gets the stored outcome.
